items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Now, on "Talk Of The Town," Coleman Hawkins solo on that is one of the prettiest things you ever heard.

ctx.x: one thing, the reeds are playing another. Right on it. Yeah. Ain't nothin' but space(?). That's the reason I liked it, especially for dancing.

For sweet stuff, something to sit and listen to, with all that weird voicing and weird sound, I prefer Duke. Fletcher, I'd hardly ever hear him play no sweet. Now, on "Talk Of The Town," Coleman Hawkins solo on that is one of the prettiest things you ever heard. He put the ...(?).. in D, that's the reason it sounds so pretty.
Oh, you mean you put it in the key of D.
